title: A Snail Fires a Harpoon as Fast as a Bullet in 100 Microseconds

scenes.text: A snail fires a harpoon as fast as a bullet.
The cat cone snail hunts fish with a tooth fired like a harpoon by hydraulic pressure.
The strike takes less than a hundred microseconds.
That's about seventy thousand times the acceleration of a car.
It's the fastest movement of any mollusk, by about ten times.
That speed likely lets it hit fish before they can escape.

first_comment: Bonus: scientists are puzzled because the fish it hunts move about 100 times slower than the strike. Why so fast?
